meta.title: Implement error node caching for improved TreeView user experience
meta.body_summary: Add error node caching in base branch data provider to prevent repeated failed operations on tree refresh, with retry command and contextValue non-readonly changes for improved UX.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added error node caching; tnaum-ms simplified and added contextValue non-readonly; bk201- questioned design; PR closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 25275 changed lines across 144 files, this is a very large change by absolute volume, but the feature-specific changes are small (BaseCachedBranchDataProvider.ts ~83 lines, retryOperation.ts ~60 lines) while most churn comes from repeated merge branches into main. As a moderate feature PR it was closed without merge after design review stalled.

review_details.concern_detail: bk201- questioned making contextValue non-readonly, suggesting that constructor or getTreeItem() should be used instead; this blocked progress.
review_details.performance_claim: Error node caching prevents repeated failed operations on tree refresh, improving responsiveness.
review_details.rejection_signals: Design objection on making contextValue non-readonly, no resolution found; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot's initial implementation was over-engineered; maintainer simplified and added contextValue non-readonly, but this design change triggered a review objection that halted progress.

detection_detail.code_reading: bk201- reviewed the code and objected to making contextValue publicly writable; tnaum-ms provided manual test video.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data; maintainer provided a video demonstrating functional fix but not performance metrics.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed after design objection without resolution.

core_change_summary.description: Enhanced BaseCachedBranchDataProvider to cache error nodes by parent ID, preventing repeated failed operations on tree refresh. Added retryOperation command to clear error state and refresh. Made contextValue non-readonly across many tree items to support context propagation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line changes come from merge commits that bring in main's updates; feature scope is < 200 lines excluding mechanical readonly removal.
change_trajectory: Initial Copilot commits: error node caching infrastructure and utility functions.
Maintainer tnaum-ms refactored: simplified implementation, removed unused code, renamed retryAuthentication to retryOperation.
Maintainer made contextValue non-readonly in many files to support dynamic context assignment.
Review: Copilot bot suggested nitpicks (unawaited promises, naming); maintainer adopted param rename.
Human reviewer bk201- questioned design of non-readonly contextValue; no resolution, PR closed.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot provided overview and suggested using Promise.all for fallback refresh and renaming parameter; some suggestions adopted.
Explained that non-await for fallback is intentional and retry node detection is by design.
Questioned making contextValue non-readonly, suggesting alternatives; no resolution.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot created initial implementation with error cache and tests.
Maintainer tnaum-ms heavily refactored: simplified, removed tests, introduced contextValue non-readonly.
Copilot bot reviewed and suggested minor improvements.
Maintainer addressed some suggestions and requested review.
Human reviewer bk201- objected to non-readonly contextValue; discussion stalled.
